content: Chuscu waranga runacuna micunanpag milagruta Jesucristo rurashgan
Tsaypita atsca runacuna Jesús cagman juntacaptin micapäcunanpag imapis mana cargantsu. Tsaymi discïpuluncunata Jesús gayaycur caynog nergan:
“Cuyapämi caycho nogantsiwan caycag runacunata. Paycuna quimsa junagnami nogantsiwan caycho caycan micuyta mana yawaylapa.
Waquin cäga shapäcamushga caru marcapitami. Micönila wayincunapa cuticunanpag niptëga aywaycaptilannami vëtapis tsarenga.”
Tsaynog niptinmi discïpuluncuna nergan: “¿Chunyag jircacho caycarga maychörag tarishwan micuyta caytsica runacunapäga, tayta?”
Tsauraga paycunata Jesús taporgan: “¿Aycalatag tantayqui caycan?” Tsauraga nipäcorgan: “Ganchislami caycan, tayta.”

Tsaynog niptinmi lapan runacunata nergan jamacärinanpag. Jamacäriptinnami ganchis tantata aptarcur Tayta Diosta Jesús manacur agradëcicorgan. Nircurnami paquircur paquircur discïpuluncunata macyargan paycuna aypupäcunanpag.
Tsaynoglami juc ishcay acapala pescädutapis Jesusman apapargan. Tsaycunatapis aptarcushpan Tayta Diosta manacur agradëcicorgan. Nircur tsaycunatapis discïpuluncunata macyargan runacunata aypunanpag.
Tsaymi lapan micapäcorgan sacsashganyag. Putsushgancunatanami shuntargan ganchis canasta juntata.
Tsaycho micogcunaga cargan chuscu waranganogmi (4,000). Micuyta usharcuptinnami lapan runacunata Jesús despachargan.
Tsaypitanami büquiman witsarcur discïpuluncunawan Jesuspis aywacorgan Dalmanuta nishgan partiman.
Milagrutarag Jesucristo rurananta munapäcushgan
Dalmanuta nishgan partiman chayaycuptinmi fariseucuna aywaycur Jesusta achäquita ashipar caynog nipäcorgan: “Tayta Diosnintsi rasunpa cachamushushgayquita musyapäcunäpag mä ima milagrutapis ruray.”
Tsaynog niptinmi Jesús laquicushpan caynog nergan: “¿Imanirtag munarcaycanqui milagrutarag ruranäta? Gamcuna munashgayquinöga manami ima milagrutapis rurashagtsu.”
Nircurna runacunata tsaycho cachaycur büquiman witsarcushpan discïpuluncunawan aywacorgan lagünapa jucag cuchunman.
Fariseucunapa yachatsicuyninta mana chasquicärinanpag Jesucristo tantyatsishgan
Lagünata tsimpaycashganchömi Jesuspa discïpuluncuna yarparcorgan mircapanpag juc tantalata aparcaycashganta.
Tsaymi Jesús caynog nergan: “Fariseo runacunapa y rey Herodispa levadüranta cuidädu chasquipäcunquiman.”
Tsaynog niptin discïpuluncuna quiquinpura caynog nipäcorgan: “Tantata mana mircapacamushgantsipitami tsaynog niycämantsi.”
Tsaynog parlaycashganta tantyarmi Jesús nergan: “¿Imanirtag parlarcaycanqui tantata mana apamushgayquipita? ¿Gamcuna manacu tantyapäcunquirag imata niycashgätapis?
Milagrucunata rurashgäta ricaycarpis gamcunaga mana ricagnogmi carcaycanqui. Yachatsishgäcunata mayaycarpis mana mayagnogmi carcaycanqui. ¿Manacu yarpapäcunqui ricashgayquita y mayashgayquitapis?

Pitsga tantalapita pitsga waranga (5,000) runacunapag milagruta rurashgäpita putsogta ¿ayca canasta juntatatag shuntapäcorgayqui?” “Chunca ishcay (12) canasta juntatami shuntapäcorgä, tayta” nipäcorgan discïpuluncuna.
“Tsaynogpis ganchis tantata chuscu waranga (4,000) runacunapag milagruta ruraptë putsogta ¿ayca canastatatag shuntapäcorgayqui?” “Ganchis canasta juntatami shuntapäcorgä, tayta” nipäcorgan.
Tsauraga Jesús nergan: “Milagrucunata rurashgäta ricaycarpis ¿manacu tantyapäcunquirag?”
Betsaidacho gapra runata Jesucristo aliyätsishgan
Tsaypita discïpuluncunawan Jesús chayargan Betsaida marcaman. Tsaycho caycaptinna payman pushapäcorgan gapra runata. Nircur ruwapäcorgan gaprata aliyätsinanpag.
Tsauraga maquinpita janchacurcur marcapita Jesús jorgorgan. Tsaychöna gaprapa nawinman togaycur maquinta jananman churargan. Nircurna taporgan: “¿Ricanquinacu?”
Tsauraga gapra rama ramala ricar nergan: “Au, ricänami rama ramalaga runacunata yöracunanog caycagta. Itsanga purircaycanmi.”
Tsauraga nawinta yapay yataycuptin shumagna ricargan.
Tsaynog aliyarcatsirmi tsay runata Jesús nergan: “Marcaman mana chayaylapa y pitapis mana wilapaylapa wayiquiman cuticuy.”
Jesucristoga Tayta Dios cachamushgan Cristo cashganta Pedro nishgan
Tsaypita Jesús discïpuluncunawan aywargan Cesarea de Filipuspa caseriuncunaman. Aywarcaycashganchömi discïpuluncunata Jesús caynog nir taporgan: “¿Pï cashgätatag nogapag runacuna yarpapäcun?”

Tsaynog tapuptin discïpuluncuna caynog nipäcorgan: “Waquin runacunaga nipäcun Juan Bautista cashgayquitami. Waquinnami nipäcun Elías cashgayquita. Y waquinnami nipäcun maygan profëtapis cawarimushga cashgayquita.”
Tsaynog niptin paycunata Jesús taporgan: “Gamcunaga, ¿pï cashgätatag yarpapäcunqui?” Tsauraga Pedro nergan: “Gamga Tayta Dios cachamushgan Cristumi canqui, tayta.”
Tsaynog niptinmi Jesús caynog nergan: “Tsaytaga pitapis ama wilapanquitsu.”
Wanunanpag cashganta Jesucristo wilacushgan

Tsaypitanami discïpuluncunata Jesús wilapargan caynog nir: “Noga fiyupa nacatsishgaragmi cashagpag. Israel mayor runacuna, mandag cüracuna y Moisés escribishgan leycunata yachatsegcuna conträ sharcurmi wanutsimanga. Tsaypita quimsa junagtaga cawarimushagpagmi.”
Tsaynog cananpag cashganta wilapaptinmi Jesusta Pedro gayargan juc läduman quiquilanta parlapänanpag. Nircurnami Jesusta nergan wanutsinanpag cashganta musyaycarga Jerusalenman mana aywananpag.

Tsaynog niptinmi Jesús tantyargan Pedro tsaynog parlananpag Satanás yarpayta goshganta. Tsaymi Pedruta Jesús caynog nergan: “¡Naupäpita witicuy, Satanás! Tsaynog michämashpayquega manami munanquitsu Tayta Diosnintsi munashganta ruranäta, sinöga yarpashgayquinogla cananta munarmi tsapata churapaycämanqui.”

Nircur discïpuluncunata y runacunata gayaycur caynog nergan: “Pipis discïpulö cayta munarga shongun yarpashgannog jutsata rurar ama cawatsuntsu. Tsaypa trucanga imanog nacarpis noga munashgänogla imaypis cawatsun.
Noga munashgänog cawananpa trucan quiquin munashgannog cawagcunaga infiernuman gaycushgami cangapag. Ima nacaycho carpis noga munashgänog cawagcunami itsanga gloriaman chayangapag.
“Infiernuman gaycushga cananpag caycaptenga ¿imapagtag välin mayjina rïcu cashganpis?
Mayjina rïcu carpis manami rïcu cashgalanwanga salvacionta rantengatsu.
Pipis runacunapa naupancho nogapita y wilacuynëpita pengacuptenga nogapis Tayta Diospa angilnincunawan chip-chipyaycar cutimushpä payta manami cäsushagtsu.”

footnotes.text: Tsay witsan Israel runacuna yarpapäcorgan Cristuta Tayta Dios cachamuptin Roma runacunata Israel nacionpita gargunanpag cashgantami. Tsaynog yarpaptinpis Jesucristo manami guërrata rurananpagtsu shamushga, sinöga nogantsi-raycu cruzcho wanunanpagmi. Tsaymi discïpuluncunata nergan Cristo cashganta pitapis mana wilapänanpag. Wanushganpita cawarircamurmi itsanga nergan pï-maytapis wilapänanpag (San Mateo 17.9; 28.19).
